nodes.title: Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. your picture)
Prompt Each Pixaroma (2. one light or season per row)

rows.text: Make it a snowy winter day: a thick layer of fresh snow on the red tile roof, the top of the white wall, the terrace floor, the wicker armchair and the side table, a few snowflakes falling, and a soft overcast grey-white sky over a cold grey sea. Soft, even daylight with no hard shadows. Keep the house, the blue door and shutters, the furniture and the framing exactly unchanged.

Make it a clear night: a deep navy-blue sky with a full moon above the sea and a few stars, the whole scene dim: the white walls in cool blue moonlight, warm yellow light glowing from the window behind the blue shutters, and a small wall lamp beside the door casting a warm pool of light on the terrace stones. The wicker armchair, the side table and the potted aloe sit in the same dim blue moonlight, their sides facing the door touched by the warm lamp light, with soft dark shadows under them. Keep the house, the blue door and shutters, the furniture and the framing in the same place and shape.

Relight it at sunset: the sun low over the sea on the left, its warm orange light grazing the white walls from the left, the sky fading from orange near the sea to pale pink and blue above, golden reflections on the sea. The same low warm light falls on the wicker armchair, the side table and the aloe from the left, lighting their left sides orange, and each casts a long soft shadow to the right across the terrace stones. Keep the house, the blue door and shutters, the furniture and the framing in the same place and shape.

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 FLUX 3 needs ComfyUI 0.41.0 or newer, the first version with FLUX 3. On an older ComfyUI, Load CLIP has no flux3 type and some nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 FLUX 3 needs a free approval first (one time only)

Black Forest Labs keeps the FLUX 3 files behind a short approval on Hugging Face. Until you do it, every FLUX 3 download link below answers "Access to model ... is restricted ... Please log in".

  1. Log in to Hugging Face (a free account).
  2. Open the FLUX 3 model page with the button below and click Agree and access repository. Access is given at once.
  3. Now the download links below work, in the same browser.

FLUX 3 Klein on Hugging Face 

 Downloading with ComfyUI-Manager or a script needs a Hugging Face token as well (hf auth login). In the browser, being logged in is enough.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download flux3-image-klein-int8-convrot.safetensors5.83 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/flux3

Create the flux3 folder if it does not exist.

Take the file WITHOUT base in its name: that is the distilled (fast) model these workflows use. The files with base in the name are the base model, made for training LoRAs: it needs CFG 3.5 and 25 to 50 steps, and at the settings here (15 or 16 steps, CFG 1) its pictures come out smeared and broken.

Already have flux3_image_klein_sd_int8_convrot.safetensors? That is the same file under its first name (ComfyUI's own template used it at launch). Pick it in this node instead of downloading it again.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot.safetensors4.86 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

 Load VAE

Download flux2-vae.safetensors336 MB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

The same file as Flux 2 Klein: if you have it, skip this one.

 License

FLUX 3 Image Klein is released under the FLUX Kommunity License. You may use the pictures commercially only while your yearly revenue (all the money coming in, before costs), together with any company you belong to, is under US$5 million. Read it before you use the model for paid work.

FLUX 3 Klein model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Change the season, the time of day or the light of a picture, and keep everything in it. The demo turns a sunny Greek house into a snowy winter day, a moonlit night and a sunset, in one Run.

 Steps

  1. Load your picture in Load Image Mini Pixaroma.
  2. In Prompt Each Pixaroma, keep one light or season per row. Switch off the rows you do not want this time, or write your own in a new row.
  3. Leave the seed on F to repeat the results, or switch it to R to try new ones every Run.
  4. Press Run once: it makes one picture per row.

 Writing new light

  • Say where the light comes from, its colour and what it touches, the furniture too: the same low warm light falls on the wicker armchair, the side table and the aloe from the left, lighting their left sides orange, and each casts a long soft shadow to the right.
  • For a season, say where the snow, the leaves or the rain go: fresh snow on the red tile roof, the terrace floor and the wicker armchair.
  • Name the light sources that should glow: warm yellow light glowing from the window, a small wall lamp beside the door.
  • End with what must stay: Keep the house, the blue door and shutters, the furniture and the framing in the same place and shape. Exactly unchanged also keeps their old light, unless the prompt says what changes on them: the winter row can use it because it puts snow on every piece of furniture.

 On a person

We relit a portrait three ways (golden window light, moonlight with a warm lamp, a dramatic studio light). Her face stayed hers on every seed, but the light changed little: the distilled model mostly made her warmer or bluer. Try this row on a portrait:

Relight the portrait with warm, low golden-hour sunlight coming through a window from the left: a bright warm patch of light across the left side of her face and hair, the right side of her face in soft shadow, a warm glow on the copper hair and a small catchlight in each eye. Keep her face, her expression, her hair, the yellow t-shirt, her pose and the framing exactly unchanged.

 Good to know

  • Our first night and sunset wording ended with the furniture ... exactly unchanged, and the armchair stayed in daylight under the moon on all 4 seeds. Saying what the new light does to it fixed that on all 4.
  • A light source you name can appear. The portrait row above says through a window, and a tester got a window added behind her, with her background replaced. On a portrait outdoors, name a light that fits the place, like the low sun.
  • Every row uses the same seed. The demo seed 3 was good for all three; another seed can suit one row better than the others.
  • The result has the shape of your picture at about 1 megapixel.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (FLUX 3 Klein, distilled) - The image model, FLUX 3 Image Klein from Black Forest Labs, the distilled version (no base in the file name): 16 steps for an edit, CFG 1. It makes a picture from words AND changes a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 4B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something FLUX 3 understands. The type must be flux3.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2 VAE) - Turns the finished render into a picture. FLUX 3 uses the same VAE as Flux 2.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. your picture) - The picture to relight. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Prompt Each Pixaroma (2. one light or season per row) - One whole edit prompt per row: a snowy winter day, a moonlit night and a sunset. Press Run once and it sends the rows through one after the other, so one Run makes one picture per row. Switch a row off with its ON button to skip it.
  • Seed Pixaroma (3. fixed or random) - The seed, the same for every row. F (fixed) repeats the results, R (random) tries new ones every Run. The demo uses seed 3.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (reads the edit prompt) - Reads the prompt through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (empty negative) - An empty negative prompt. FLUX 3 distilled runs at CFG 1, where the negative does nothing, but the KSampler still needs one plugged in.
  • Set Reference Multi Latent (your picture, about 1 megapixel) - Hands your picture to FLUX 3 as the picture to change, for the prompt and for the empty negative. Set to resize, 1 megapixel: the result has the shape of your picture at about 1 megapixel. It also gives the KSampler its blank canvas, so there is no size to set.
  • KSampler (16 steps) - The edit: 16 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple, the settings of Black Forest Labs' own FLUX 3 Klein distilled edit workflow.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Preview Image Pixaroma (one picture per row, saved) - Shows every picture of the Run and saves them into ComfyUI/output/Flux 3 Klein Relight.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
The three rows of the demo, one Runabout 14 s
Each rowabout 4.5 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (FLUX 3 and its text encoder, about 11 GB together), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
